additional_info.subject: ID0453176-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / P9 170000775] Charging is unsuccessful at Outlet-2 CRM:03056000064
additional_info.body:
Hi Emre-abi,
I checked the charger and found that the CableCheck voltage is not being noticed and as such it's not going forward, but we have the voltage reading from the converters.
Please check the following:
TF2's 2...10V output is not being read properly.
QA13-14 is not closing
Check the 24V supply to the C1-C2. It's possible that XD10.3 is loose.
Check with crocodile tips the busbar directly after the contactors.
I recommend you to measure on the roof busbars as they are much easier to access instead of the busbars which are deeply inside the charger.
If we don't have voltage then that means that the contactor is not closing.
If the 24V are applied to C1-C2 and it's not closing, replace the contactors.
If you don't see 24V please measure from the KF13 until there, if the KF13 is not sending the 24V please trial replacing it.
So please take spare QA13-14, TF2 and KF13 to site.
I will forward this ticket to your RC-TR queue. If you require assistance please schedule it with at least 2 days in advance as I need prepare my calendar.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
